description: App Store keyword ranks for one app, per storefront: the search terms Apptiller tracks and the candidate terms it found, each with its rank on the latest check (null: not in the first 100), the day of that check, the median rank of the last 7 days and of the 7 before and the change, up to 21 days of rank history, difficulty (from the ratings the top 10 hold, and the store's own 0-100 score when read), the app holding #1, relevance to the app and why (as judged by a model over several runs), the sources that suggested the term, Apple Ads numbers for the same search, and App Store autocomplete suggestions. rank_error says why the last rank check failed, and rank_held why the last run left a tracked term out for the plan. Per storefront, search_pulse sets App Store search impressions over the last complete week against the week before, with the tracked terms that moved the same way. Ranks are read once a day on a plan and once a week without one. Read-only: it finds, tracks or drops no terms, and runs no rank check.

country.description: Only this storefront, e.g. US. Every storefront when left out.

include_dropped.description: Also list the terms that were dropped.

name: app_store_keywords
title: App Store keyword ranks
